value.rationale: The optimum \(10\) was already known, but a complete equality-case classification is a natural missing invariant. The \(192\)-code census is compressed by a Petersen-graph bijection model into three matching cycle types and three canonical isometry orbits, providing structural information and reproducible benchmark data rather than merely re-evaluating the known optimum.
